name: likelyfad-prompt-system
description: Agent-loadable prompt skills in three systems (image, video, audio). Start from AGENTS.md: it asks what you want to create and loads the right skill.

plugins.name: character-casting
plugins.description: Turn a full ad script into a minimal cast plan, then character reference sheets (5-view full body or 3-view chest-up), reference-guided before/after transformation edits, and location references — in Pixar simple, Pixar high fidelity, Realistic Movie or UGC iPhone style. Every character a unique, recognisable, age-true individual. Seedream 5.0 Pro or Nano Banana Pro prompts.

plugins.name: nano-banana
plugins.description: Write ready-to-paste Google Nano Banana Pro image prompts and conversational edits: product, lifestyle and UGC stills, thumbnails, text-heavy posters, comparison and before/after images, language variants, infographics, keyframes and first frames for video.

plugins.name: ai-ugc
plugins.description: Turn a script + reference images into ready-to-paste realistic UGC talking-head video-ad prompts. Current model: Google Gemini Omni (swappable).

plugins.name: ai-ugc-seedance
plugins.description: Turn a script + reference images (+ an optional voice sample) into ready-to-paste realistic UGC video-ad prompts for ByteDance Seedance 2.0 — selfie, friend-held, or tripod creator videos, including multi-clip ad series stitched in the edit. Built on production prompts that rendered well. Current model: ByteDance Seedance 2.0 (swappable).

plugins.name: ai-animation
plugins.description: Turn a finished script or narration + already-made images into ready-to-paste animated video prompts in two separate styles: Pixar/Disney 3D ads and the direct 3D explainer (the "Zack D" style, fast hard-cut explainers with narration in post). Also beat-cut music videos (finished song + SRT) and sung lip-sync jingles. Current model: ByteDance Seedance 2.0 (swappable).

plugins.name: ai-song
plugins.description: Turn a finished ad script (often 3 hooks + 1 body) into ready-to-paste Suno song prompts — a Style field + the script sung verbatim inside structure tags + settings — for a high-energy, non-rap brand song. Current model: Suno v6 Pro (swappable).

plugins.name: elevenlabs-voice
plugins.description: Turn a plain spoken script into an optimised ElevenLabs Eleven v3 script (audio tags, punctuation, casing, spelled-out numbers) plus delivery notes, for voiceovers, ad reads, narration and dialogue.
